headline: Atlassian and OpenAI connect frontier intelligence to enterprise context
focus: Applied Generative AI for Knowledge Workers

source.title: Grounding Frontier Intelligence in Enterprise Context

summary: Atlassian and OpenAI are deepening their partnership around the idea that frontier intelligence needs access to the goals, knowledge, people, and processes that shape enterprise work. Atlassian positions its Teamwork Graph and systems of record as a context layer for reasoning about live organizational state.
why_it_matters: Better models alone do not solve the enterprise context problem. Useful workplace AI must identify the right project, decision, owner, permission, and source of truth, while keeping people involved in consequential work.
related_coverage: This complements persistent assistants by showing the organizational context and permissions needed for continuity to become useful rather than noisy.
image_alt_intent: Layered-system diagram showing model reasoning grounded through identity, permissions, organizational context, systems of record, workflow actions, and review.
